review_notes: The implementation successfully encapsulates the 'Calm Insight' design direction. The background uses CSS-based fluid blobs for an aurora effect (Generative UI) which is lightweight but effective. The 'Elderly Mode' toggle uses Framer Motion for a layout flip, enlarging text, hiding complex charts, and simplifying language and metrics display. The sync interaction provides a clear feedback loop. The project fulfills all requirements of the prompt and pipeline guidelines.
